videos.title: 50 Rock Heroes of the 90s!
videos.description: Claire Sturgess relives her 50 greatest rock heroes with the music that defined the 90s! Blur, Foo Fighters, Oasis and Nirvana are all in the top 10 - but who is at number 1?

videos.title: The 90s: Guitars, Grunge & Glory!
videos.description: Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger and everyone brought riffs, anthems and questionable hair!

videos.title: All Killer: Stateside Anthems!
videos.description: In order, 20 of the biggest American anthems from the 21st Century featuring The Killers, Bon Jovi, Nickelback and One Republic.

videos.title: The New Legends Of Rock
videos.description: Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!

videos.title: 50 Reasons The 10s Rocked!
videos.description: 50 anthems of rock from the 2010s! With the 1975, Wolf Alice, Linkin Park, Royal Blood, Paramore, Biffy Clyro, YUNGBLUD & much more!

videos.title: Weekend Anthems!
videos.description: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems, featuring Kings of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro, and the Foo Fighters.

videos.title: 30 Biggest Rock Anthems!
videos.description: 30 of the biggest, timeless anthems! Featuring legendary acts like Aerosmith, Kiss, and Queen, through to Razorlight, Fall Out Boy and Evanescence.

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

videos.title: Nicky Horne's Rock Party Anthems
videos.description: Nicky Horne presents his favourite 30 rock party anthems of all time, featuring Led Zeppelin, Def Leppard, Thin Lizzy and David Bowie.

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

videos.title: All Killer: 00s Karaoke!
videos.description: Turn your amp up to 11 and make your mic roar! Here come 25 of the greatest 00s rock karaoke tracks. Featuring The Killers, Fall Out Boy, Arctic Monkeys, and many more!

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

videos.title: Yeah Baby! It's the 60s!
videos.description: 25 classic 60s hits that defined an era! Turn on, tune in and rock out to The Stones, The Beatles, Jimi Hendrix, Bob Dylan and many more legends of classic rock!

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

videos.description: The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickelback & Evanescence.

videos.description: These are the legendary rock stars that made the 80s! Expect Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler, Queen, Bon Jovi, AC/DC, Iron Maiden & loads more!

videos.title: Loud & Legendary: The 20 Greatest!
videos.description: The most iconic and ear-shattering rock songs that shaped the genre! Including Led Zeppelin's timeless Whole Lotta Love and AC/DC's rebellious Highway to Hell. Crank it up and enjoy!

videos.title: The United States Of Rock
videos.description: Nothing but Anthems from the USA! From AC/DC, Guns N Roses and Bon Jovi to Aerosmith, Green Day and Blondie.

videos.title: Suzi Q's US Rock Legends
videos.description: A musical journey through sixty years of the finest American rock'n'roll, from Elvis and Jerry Lee Lewis to Nirvana and Green Day.

videos.title: The Anthems!
videos.description: Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems, featuring Kings of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro, and the Foo Fighters!

videos.description: A 2-hour run-through, in order, of top 3 hits from the 90s - all with that rock 'n' roll swagger! Expect plenty of U2, Def Leppard, Meat Loaf & Britpop!

videos.title: Killer Cuts Of The 00s!
videos.description: A decade of mega hits and the loudest anthems! Expect Biffy Clyro, Linkin Park, Blink 182, Evanescence, Fall Out Boy & loads more!

videos.description: A definitive 6-hour marathon of 00s rock anthems in order! From Alien Ant Farm to The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy to The Foo Fighters, Weezer to the White Stripes.
